verdict.rationale: LangSmith is an API-backed SaaS platform, so versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows that an API exists (traces can be filtered and exported 'via the UI or API') and that SDKs are available. Nothing documents API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation/sunset policy, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path.
